hypothesis: M191 validates M189 on fresh behavior seeds and existing M183 proof surfaces, but M190 shows a fixed-objective plateau and the retained proof rows are still inherited from M183. Before stage4 PPO, refresh the proof surface so promotion is not driven by repeated optimization against the same boundary rows.
success_criteria: do not train a new PPO checkpoint
keep runs/ppo_m189_stage3_from_m188_seed5193/checkpoint.pt as the current best checkpoint under evaluation
build or evaluate a fresh source-diverse matched-current or boundary-relocated proof surface that is not just the M183 row set
include wrong-history, reset-hidden, zero-response, and no-action-history interventions where the harness supports them
report physical-pair, source-step, obstacle-bucket, and left-step diversity
decide whether stage4 PPO is justified or whether objective/proof-surface design must change first
failure_criteria: run stage4 PPO before refreshing the proof surface
reuse only the M183 boundary rows and call it independent evidence
change actor inputs or observation profiles during this gate
accept a duplicate-dominated surface as promotion evidence
